jobs.description:
GF Industry and Infrastructure Flow Solutions, a division of GF, is the world's leading supplier of piping systems. We enable the safe and sustainable transport of fluids. Our business is driven by industry-leading sustainability levels, innovation through digital solutions and investment in a culture based on performance, learning and caring.
If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and global collaboration — you’ll feel right at home with us.

Join us as a Innovation Engineer – Data Center Cooling and play a key role in shaping next-generation cooling solutions for a rapidly growing market. In this position, you will drive front-end innovation and develop scalable, manufacturable concepts that contribute to a product portfolio. You will work on cutting-edge technologies such as manifolds, cold plates, and advanced joining solutions while influencing critical early-stage decisions. With a high degree of autonomy and strategic scope, you will collaborate closely with Product Management, R&D, and customers. This is a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on high-impact, early-stage innovation projects.

Innovation Engineer – Data Center Cooling (m/f/d)

Your tasks:

• Take end-to-end technical ownership from idea generation through concept development, prototyping, feasibility validation, and manufacturability - especially for polymer-based components

• Serve as the key front-end technical interface between Product Management, R&D, and customers

• Translate market and customer needs into robust technical concepts and support the definition of target product profiles

• Prepare structured front-end deliverables and support specification development for smooth handover to the R&D teams

• Perform engineering analyses such as pressure-loss calculations, thermal assessments, and basic structural evaluations

• Analyze system layouts and isometries to support dimensioning, integration, and overall system design

• Build and expand application know-how to assess and unlock new business opportunities

• Collaborate closely with Product, Portfolio Management, and customers to shape innovative solutions

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Materials, Plastics Engineering or similar)

• 6 - 9 years of experience, including at least 2 years in data center cooling

• Strong expertise in Direct Liquid Cooling, fluid dynamics, pressure-loss calculations, and basic thermal system design

• Ability to assess structural integrity of piping and plastic components and translate concepts into robust designs

• Strong ownership, hands-on problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently and communicate effectively across stakeholders

• Proficiency in CAD tools (e.g., Siemens NX) with experience in prototyping and plastics engineering

• Fluent in English (German is a plus)

• Information: The position can be filled in Schaffhausen, US, or Taiwan

jobs.description:
Shape our brand, inspire audiences, and bring bold ideas to life.

We are looking for a creative and strategic thinker who can transform insights into impactful brand experiences. In this role, you will combine hands-on graphic design expertise with strategic brand thinking to strengthen and evolve our global brand presence. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies worldwide, you will develop compelling concepts, ensure brand consistency, and bring creative ideas to life across multiple channels and markets.

Creative Strategist (m/f/d)

Your tasks:

• Develop creative strategies, concepts, storylines, and campaigns that align with business objectives and strengthen our global brand

• Shape, maintain, and further evolve our corporate design and brand identity, ensuring consistency across all channels, touchpoints, and markets worldwide

• Translate market trends, audience insights, and business needs into engaging brand experiences and impactful creative solutions

• Support and coordinate global marketing, communication, and employer branding campaigns in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external agencies

• Act as the creative link between business teams and agency partners, providing guidance, feedback, and ensuring high-quality deliverables

• Create and oversee visual assets for digital channels, social media, events, presentations, and marketing communications while contributing hands-on design expertise

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree or a vocational apprenticeship with relevant further training in Graphic Design, Communication, Marketing, or a related field

• At least 3 years of professional experience in graphic design, branding, creative strategy, marketing, communications, or a comparable role, ideally in an international B2B environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in graphic and corporate design, storytelling, campaign development, and creative thinking

• Proven ability to connect strategic, big-picture thinking with hands-on creative execution and brand management

• Experience collaborating with multiple stakeholders, international teams, and external creative agencies, combined with strong project management skills

• Excellent English communication skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset; additional languages are an advantage

• Please include work samples or a portfolio with your application
